tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dpal ldan bla ma dam pa'i mdzad pa'i bsnyen pa byed tshul bzhugs/

zab mo gsang sngags bzlas gyur na/ tshe 'dir smin grol thob par the tshom med/ oṃ shrī tsakra saṃ bha ra bhyeḥ sbyor ba bsnyen pa gang la'ang thog mar mtshams 'og tu mi mang nyung gang bcug kyang chog cing thog mar mtshams 'og tu bcug pa phyis mi 'jug mtshams 'debs pa'i tshe dgong mo bya zhing*/ grol ba snga dro grol bar bya'o/ /thun gyi skabs ngag sdom zhing*/ ngag bcad pa'i sngags de bsnyen pa'i grags su rtsi zhing*/ thun mtshams rnams su ngag bcad gcig tu mi dgos/ sngags gang 'grub 'grub sgrongs/ thun mtshams kyi sngags grangs su mi rtsi/ bsnyen pa'i 'phreng ba mi gzhan gyis ma mthong bar byed/ khyad par 'khor lo sdom pa'i skabs/ mtshams tho brtsigs nas sa der sngon 'gro gtor ma btang*/ de skabs sa'i phyogs 'dir bdag 'khor lo sdom pa'i dkyil 'khor sgrub par 'tshal na/ dkar po'i phyogs la mngon par dga' ba'i zhes sogs 'phrin las bcol/ spyir thun bzhir bshad na'ang*/ sngags 'gro che ba'i stabs snga thun dgong thun gnyis mdzad/ thun mtshams nyin dgung yod pa mdzad/ gtor ma dgong thun gyi mjug srod kyi dus bsngo/ de yang thogs ma yi dam la 'bul rgyu dang*/ mkha' 'gro spyi gtor de gtor ma gnyis bya dgos kyi chos skyong yod na'ang gtor ma 'cha'/ gtor ma'i mdun du nang mchod dang*/ chu gnyis nyer spyod lnga bshams/ de nas nyi ma re re bzhin/ 'theb skyus sngar gyi gtor ma de dgos pa yin/ thun gyi skabs yig brgya song ba'i rjes su nang mchod byin rlabs dmigs pa gang gsal gyi rgyas pa bya/ nang mchod byin rlabs gting ma gnyis la rgyas bsdus skabs dang bstun pa'i rung*/ mngon rtogs kyi mgo mjug tu sems ma yengs pa dgos shing*/ dmigs pa gsal rung mi gsal rung*/ tshig so so'i thad du rnam pa lam lam dran pa'i shar sgom tshar re gal che/ dag pa dran pa'i rjes su 'phreng ba byin rlabs re byed dgos shing*/

de yang bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las hrīḥlas padma hrīḥmatshan pa las 'od dpag med dmar po phyag dang po gnyis padma dang dril bu 'dzin pas/ yum gos dkar mo gri thod 'dzin pa la 'khyud pa/ 'og la gnyis kyis ḍā ma ru dang kha ṭwāṃ ga /g.yas brkyang gi stabs kyi bzhugs pa/ de'i snying khar oṃ ha dkar po nas tsinṭi ka'i bar dang*/ gnas gsum du oṃ āḥhūṃ/ ye shes sems dpa' dang dbang gi lha pheṃ/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par thim/ oṃ badzra bha wa abhi ṣiñtsa hūṃ zhes dbang bskur/ 'od dpag med kyi dbu brgyan/ de zhu ba las byung ba'i phreng bar 'gyur/ oṃ āḥdzi hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ lan brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas pa ni 'phreng ba byin rlabs so/ /de nas sum bha lan bdun tsam bzlas/ de nas yab yum gyi rtsa sngags tshar gcig song nas/ yab yum sgrags pa'i snying po gnyis la grangs 'dzin/ thun gcig la yab yum gyi sngags su song ba de'i bcu cha/ dpa' bo dpa' mo nyer bzhi'i sngags bzlas/ de'i bcu cha yum bzhi dang sgo mtshams ma brgyad kyi sngags bzlas pas/ gtso 'khor dus mnyam du bsnyen pa 'gro bzhin/ yang de mi bde na thog mar gtso bo yab yum gyi bsnyen pa rdzogs pa'i dus su/ rim pa bzhin du 'khor rnams so so la bsnyen pa byas pa'i rung*/ de'i tshe gtso bo yab yum la 'bum phrag bzhi/ yum bzhi la stong phrag bzhi bzhi/ dpa' bo dpa' mo nyer bzhi la/ bzhi khri re/ sgo mtshams ma brgyad la/ yum bzhi dang 'dra/ yab yum gyi bzlas pa dang*/ rnam pa dang*/ nga rgyal la slob pa'i dmigs pa ni/ dkyus nas gsal zhing 'khor du slebs pa'i skabs/ rang rang so so'i thugs kar pad zla la sngags bkod la/ klog pa'i tshul gyis bzla/ sngags gang bzla rung lha thams cad dang*/ gtso bo yang zhal bzhi kas bzlas par bsam mo/ /bsnyen pa grol ba'i tshe gtang rag gi tshul du gtor ma rgyas pa re gtong*/ 'grub na bsnyen pa rdzogs mtshams/

ma grol gong zhag 'ga' re gtor ma 'bul zhing*/ de nas sbyin sreg rnams kyang mtshams nang du rdzogs par byas/ mtshams grol/ bsnyen pa'i thun mtshams skabs gtam 'chal chol mang po mi smra zhing*/ sgrub g.yog pas kyang skad cha gsar pa che ba rnams mi shod/ bzlas pa'i skabs sngar mi dran pa mang po dran pa dang*/ dpe cha lta ba dang*/ shor ba sogs bsnyen pa nyid ma yin pa'i bya ba gang 'dod kyang*/ bar chad du go bar byas nas spros pa gcod/ tshogs bsogs dang*/ bsrung 'khor dmigs pa gang gsal te sgom pa bar chad mi 'byung ba yin/ khyad par bsnyen pa la 'dod pa sdug pa dang dog pa tsab tshob mi byed par blo bde ba'i ngos nas lhod lhod nas bya/ nyi ma gcig la grangs 'di tsam song na ma song ni mi bya/ nang du spyod lam bag yang tsam bya/ rigs pa bcur bcur mi bya/ skra sen mi dreg gdan mi bsgul/ bla ma la gsol ba 'debs pa dang*/ gtor ma'i skabs gsol 'debs 'dun pa drag pa gal che/ zhes pa'ang slob ma 'ga' zhig gis bskul bas tā ra nā thas chos lung byang rtser bskur ba'o/ /dge legs 'phel bar gyur/ phyogs dang gnas skabs kun tu dar zhing rgyas gyur par cig/ //bkra shis/ /maṅga laṃ/ mes po'i shul bzhag las/ tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa'i mdzad pa'i bsnyen pa byed tshul bzhugs/ - PAGE 234 -- PAGE 233 - - PAGE 232 -
